headline: Callahan's Passage Yields Ground as Northern Offensives Rage
war_summary: Colonial forces have pressed their breakthrough in Callahan's Passage, securing both Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage as casualty rates surge past five hundred per hour on both sides. Weathered Expanse remains an unrelenting storm center, logging five more base exchanges across the past two hours while bitter skirmishing persists over Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Further west, Mooring County and Palantine Berm continue to consume enormous casualty tallies—each seeing over six hundred combined fallen in the past two hours—though neither sector has registered fresh territorial handovers since early morning. Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf have also witnessed reviving combat tempos, with casualty and enlistment rates accelerating sharply along their borders. Elsewhere along the front, peripheral sectors such as Stonecradle and Marban Hollow remain largely static, keeping the war's decisive friction concentrated across the bloodstained northern highlands.
